verdict.rationale: Rive's docs show automatic saving into a Revision History that tracks changes, including from multiple collaborators. You can preview any revision and restore it non-destructively with 'Edit Current Revision', which copies it to a new entry at the top. Naming milestones and comparing revisions are not evidenced; preview is only a weak stand-in for comparison. Missing for 10: named milestones/versions, side-by-side comparison or diff of revisions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
